wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.basis: schedule-total == cover line1 + line2 (the over-$50 SUBSET alone equals cover line 1 exactly)
contributions.detail: 19 typed rows sum to EXACTLY 6,699.67, the schedule's own printed total. THIS FILER ITEMISED HIS SUB-$50 DONORS TOO, so the row sum equals cover line 1 PLUS line 2 rather than line 1 alone -- and the split proves itself: the 12 rows over $50.00 sum to EXACTLY 6,524.67 = cover line 1, and the 7 rows of $50.00 or less (40.00, 50.00, 10.00, 50.00, 10.00, 10.00, 5.00) sum to EXACTLY 175.00 = cover line 2. Both readings of the sub-$50 trap therefore gate to the cent. The LAST-REPORT column is written 'N/A' on every line (first report of the cycle), so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide -- scope recorded cumulative. NOTE the two $50.00 rows are NOT 'more than $50.00' and belong in the line-2 aggregate, which is where the arithmetic puts them.

expenditures.detail: 33 typed rows sum to EXACTLY 6,699.67 -- the schedule's own printed total, the cover line 3 THIS cell and the cover line 3 CUMULATIVE cell all agree. LAST-REPORT is 'N/A' (first report of the cycle), so the two scopes coincide; recorded cumulative.

gates.page_subtotal: Form A (p2) rows 6,699.67 = the schedule's printed total 6,699.67 -- GATES; the over-$50 subset 6,524.67 = cover line 1 and the <=$50 subset 175.00 = cover line 2 -- BOTH GATE. Form B (p3) rows 6,699.67 = the schedule's printed total = cover line 3 -- GATES. Neither typed attachment prints a per-page subtotal (each is one page).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returned geometry_status 'no-reliable-geometry' (0 bands) on BOTH p2 and p3 -- the typed attachments carry only a light under-rule per row, which the detector could not resolve; per the brief the ink rows were counted by eye instead. Form A: 19 inked rows above the total rule, 19 emitted. Form B: 33 inked rows above the total rule, 33 emitted. On each page the printed schedule total sits one row-pitch below the last row, separated by its own rule, and was NOT emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: Form A p2: the first-row band renders the header double-rule and '$100.00' (row 1's value); the last-row band renders '$4,024.67' (row 19) with '$5.00' (row 18) clipped above, and one pitch below the band shows the ruled-off printed TOTAL '$6,699.67' -- i.e. no further transaction row exists, which is the control's purpose here (a printed total, not a row). Form B p3: first-row band renders '$95.65' (row 1); last-row band renders '$200.00' (row 33) with '$3.97' (row 32) above and the ruled-off printed total '$6,699.67' below. Row index confirmed unshifted on both pages.
gates.balance_chain: Cumulative column: 6,524.67 (over $50) + 175.00 (<= $50) - 6,699.67 (expenses) = 0, and the cover's line 4 prints a hand-written '0' in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells. CLOSES EXACTLY to zero. The LAST-report chain cannot be run: every LAST cell reads 'N/A'.

escalation_note: 600 dpi tight crops for the geometry proof at the head and foot of both schedules (which also re-read rows 1, 18, 19, 32 and 33), plus a 600 dpi crop of the cover money block to confirm the 'N/A' entries in the LAST column and the hand-written '0' balance. The schedules are born-typed and unambiguous at 200 dpi; the exact closure of three independent sums (over-$50, <=$50, and the grand total) is the decisive evidence.
notes: Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'CACHE COUNTY EXECUTIVE / SURVEYOR' -- a SINGLE office line naming two offices, written by the filer in block capitals. The chunk file says 'County Executive'; the DOCUMENT says Executive/Surveyor, so the chunk's office label is INCOMPLETE -- flagged loudly here. (In Cache County the elected Executive also serves as Surveyor; both are county offices, so the filing is IN SCOPE either way.) Office District 'CACHE'. Candidate 'BOYD ROGER PUGMIRE'; chunk says 'Pugmire' -- agrees. Cover date '11 JULY 2014' and the clerk RCVD stamp reads 17 JUL 2014 -- the chunk file's date column says 2014-07-25, which matches NEITHER; the document's own dates are 11 Jul (signed) and 17 Jul (received). The cover is handwritten; both schedules are typed attachments in the county's Form A / Form B layout. Contributor street addresses are printed in the clear on Form A; only city and state were kept and the street/PO box and ZIP were discarded at read time, as were the candidate's own home address, ZIP, home phone and business phone from the cover. Row 19 of Form A is the candidate himself (Boyd Pugmire, 4,024.67) -- normal self-funding, transcribed verbatim. Neither schedule has an in-kind column, so in_kind is false throughout by construction.
